messages:
jamie (design): dropped a compact prompt-set scorecard mock in Figma: https://figma.com/mock/compact-scorecard. aim: let owners scan regressions faster w/ minimal vertical space.
leo (pm): high level looks good. two PO asks: keep audit-friendly verbs and ensure bulk confirm for >8 items.
nina (frontend): implementation notes: will render rows as cards-in-list, add a small failure excerpt, and a compact badge for pass/fail. question: should badge include text for colorblind users?
jamie (design): yes, always include an icon + textual label (e.g., "Fail") and tooltip. also want an inline quick-action: "Approve" exposed on hover and on keyboard focus.
ara (a11y): a few quick nits: 1) keyboard focus must not be hidden in compact mode; 2) any inline action has to be reachable in the tab order; 3) announce selection counts via an aria-live region (avoid parentheses in visible labels).
leo (pm): prefer copy "Approve test(s)" rather than "Accept" so it matches event names. also toast with Undo for 8s.
nina (frontend): will add `aria-live="polite"` announcer updating like "3 tests selected" and a dismissable toast focused by screenreaders after action.
jamie (design): UX decision: expand per-row on demand. no auto-expanded rows. show "...more" button that reveals inline details; lazy render content on first open.
ara (a11y): good. ensure the "more" button has `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` and that the expanded region has `role=region` and an accessible label.
deploy-bot: preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/evals/compact-triage (build 8210) 
leo (pm): please test keyboard nav, SR announce, and copy. post quick thumbs or issues here by EOD.
jamie (design): checklist below for reviewers: - focus outlines visible - selection announcer works - badge includes text + icon - confirmation for >8 items - undo toast present
nina (frontend): pushing branch with these now, will ping when preview ready.
ara (a11y): i'll run VoiceOver and NVDA once preview is up and report any wording/announce gaps.
leo (pm): great, thanks team.
